input.reflection: Verification: The profile hotel_count=0 pattern appears in normal logs at similar proportions, so it is benign data, not a fault. The only fault signature: user.User/CheckUser spans from frontend fail 100% (errs = all calls) for every frontend endpoint that calls it (/cinema 71, /museums 58, /restaurants 59, /reservation 3, /user 3). Endpoints not calling CheckUser (/hotels, /recommendations) are healthy with normal latency. Downstream attractions/geo/search/rate/profile are not failing on their own work. Root cause: user deployment's hotel-reserv-user container fails at start with OCI error 'exec: "user": executable file not found in $PATH' (bad container command/entrypoint after a definition change), CrashLoopBackOff, deployment available=0 of desired=1 for the entire window. Attractions has no spans because frontend short-circuits after CheckUser fails (attractions deployment itself is available=1). Conclude: single root cause at user service; propagation user -> frontend -> user-facing endpoints /cinema, /museums, /restaurants, /reservation, /user.
